prompt: Create a high-quality vertical outdoor portrait photograph of a young South Asian man sitting relaxed on an ornate black wrought-iron park bench in a garden. He has medium warm skin tone, natural skin texture, thick black hair swept back with volume, dark expressive eyes, and a neatly trimmed full beard and mustache. He wears a dark chocolate-brown traditional kurta shalwar with a short stand collar and button placket, sleeves casually rolled to the forearms. His pose is calm and confident: seated slightly angled, one hand resting on his lap showing a simple silver ring and black beaded bracelet, the other hand lifted to his hair, showing a gold wristwatch. He looks directly at the camera with a serious, composed expression. Behind him is a lush flowering bougainvillea-covered arbor with vivid magenta and white blossoms, rendered with creamy shallow-depth-of-field bokeh. Use warm golden-hour sunlight from the side/back, soft natural shadows, realistic skin detail, cinematic color grading, 85mm portrait lens look, crisp subject focus, and a premium lifestyle photography feel. Vertical 9:16 composition, waist-up to full seated crop, no text, no watermark, no extra people.

promptZh: 创作一张高质量的竖构图户外肖像摄影作品，主角为 一位南亚年轻男子，他正放松地坐在花园中一张精致的黑色锻铁公园长椅上。他拥有中等暖色调的肤色、自然的皮肤质感、向后梳理且富有蓬松感的浓密黑发、深邃传神的双眼，以及修剪整齐的浓密胡须。他身穿一件深巧克力色的传统库尔塔（kurta shalwar），配有立领和门襟，袖子随意卷至前臂。他的姿态沉稳自信：身体微微侧向，一只手放在膝盖上，露出简约的银戒指和黑色串珠手链，另一只手抬起触碰头发，露出一块金色腕表。他神情严肃且从容，直视镜头。背景是茂盛的三角梅花架，开满了鲜艳的洋红色和白色花朵，呈现出柔和的浅景深虚化效果。采用侧后方的暖色调黄金时刻阳光，营造柔和的自然阴影，展现真实的皮肤细节，运用电影级色彩分级，呈现 85mm 肖像镜头的视觉效果，主体对焦清晰，具备高端生活方式摄影的质感。竖构图 9:16，腰部以上至全身坐姿裁切，无文字，无水印，无其他人物。
